name: 3DTOOLS
summary: Amazon brand selling filament titled 'Bamboo Original' with Bambu-style colour codes and an RFID claim for Bambu AMS: PLA Basic and Matte refills, PLA Silk+, PLA-CF, ABS refills, ASA and TPU, at about $23-46/kg. The seller is a Hong Kong company; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic / High Speed (refill)
product_lines.notes: 1 kg spoolless refill, $23.19-24.99; titles claim RFID for Bambu Lab AMS.

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: 1 kg, $42.99-45.99; hardness not given in titles.

additional_notes: Legal entity: HK IBOSSEN TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED (verbatim; no rendering needed), Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong (Flat 917A, Block A, New Mandarin Plaza, 14 Science Museum Road); Amazon seller '3DTOOLS Official Store' (id A2TC570GWWXPWM), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads '3DTOOLS'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. A Hong Kong holding/trading address, so the extruder is unknown. Titles use 'Bamboo Original', Bambu Lab colour codes (e.g. 'Black 10101') and RFID claims; that is naming that mimics Bambu Lab, not evidence of any Bambu relationship. The Business Name resembles the catalog's `iboss` (Qingyuan IBoss Smart Technology), but no link is established, so no relationship is recorded. HK CCTREE Technology (the `cctree` / COMTREE seller) is at Flat 917B on the same floor, a different company.

provenance.conflicts: Whether HK Ibossen is connected to Qingyuan IBoss, and whether the RFID tags work with Bambu AMS, is unknown. Extruder and manufacturing country are unknown.
